about: The palusot bank: the shortcuts Filipino builders take and do not admit. One entry per shortcut. 'viewer' is how many of the audience have done it (0 to 2, a judgement call). The seeds are starting points in native Taglish, not finished lines: the script is written fresh each episode and you read it before it is voiced (docs/canon.md CK-11, CK-12). 'fits' are the sapatos tags it can be carried into. Add an entry when you find a sentence builders say; strike nothing: used pairs are read from each episode's script.json 'formula' block (and data/formula/used.json).

palusot.title: Sino Nang Gumamit?
palusot.what: he built it before anyone asked for it
palusot.hook_seed: Claude, tapos ko na yung app. Kagabi ko lang ginawa.
palusot.plain_fix: ask the person it is for, first

palusot.title: Ikaw ang Sumulat
palusot.what: AI wrote it and he never read it, then he has to defend it
palusot.hook_seed: [whispering] Claude, ano'ng ibig sabihin ng ginawa ko?
palusot.plain_fix: understand it well enough to explain it to someone who is not technical

palusot.title: Sa Laptop Ko
palusot.what: it works on his machine and nowhere else
palusot.hook_seed: [shouting] Gumagana naman sa laptop ko!
palusot.tanong_seed: Sa laptop mo, boss. Dito ba?
palusot.plain_fix: test it where the user will use it

palusot.title: AI Naman ang Gagawa
palusot.what: he lets a client have the work for free because a machine types it
palusot.hook_seed: [shouting] Pindot-pindot lang 'yan! AI naman ang gagawa, bakit may bayad pa?
palusot.tanong_seed: Tama siya, boss. Ako ang magta-type.
palusot.plain_fix: his time has a price even when a machine types

palusot.title: Pina-attend Ko si Claude
palusot.what: he sends AI in his place
palusot.hook_seed: Claude, ikaw na ang mag-attend ng meeting ko.
palusot.plain_fix: you can hand over the notes, not the answer

palusot.title: Kanina Gumagana
palusot.what: the demo that worked a minute ago
palusot.hook_seed: [nervous] Kap, kanina po gumagana 'yan! Sumpa!
palusot.tanong_seed: Lahat ng app, boss, gumagana kanina.
palusot.plain_fix: rehearse the demo where you will give it, or record it

palusot.title: Walang WiFi
palusot.what: he cannot do it without AI any more
palusot.hook_seed: Marunong ka pa bang mag-code nang walang AI?
palusot.plain_fix: learn the thing you lean on

palusot.title: Perfect Score
palusot.what: he trusts a measure set up to flatter him
palusot.hook_seed: Sintunado ka, iho. Bakit perfect ang score mo?
palusot.plain_fix: ask for a review that can say no

palusot.title: Para Po, Boss
palusot.what: he leans on AI at the worst moment with no plan B
palusot.hook_seed: Na-hit ko na ang limit, boss.
palusot.plain_fix: know the route before you prompt

palusot.title: Baka Tao, Baka Ako
palusot.what: a fear, not a shortcut: will AI take my job (kept so the engine never picks it again)
palusot.hook_seed: Sabihin mo nang diretso, Claude. Matatanggal ba ako dahil sa'yo?
palusot.retired: a fear has no admission, so nothing is confessed

palusot.title: Final Na 'To
palusot.what: every version is called final and none of them is
palusot.hook_seed: Final na 'to, promise. Ipa-print na natin.
palusot.plain_fix: decide what done looks like before you start
palusot.frame_note: the folder of FINAL files is the frame 0 picture

palusot.title: Huling Prompt Na
palusot.what: one more prompt, all night
palusot.hook_seed: Huling prompt na 'to, promise. Tapos tulog na.
palusot.tanong_seed: 'Yan din ang sinabi mo kagabi, 'di ba, boss?
palusot.plain_fix: stop when you are tired; it will still be there tomorrow
palusot.frame_note: a dawn sky or a rooster against a lit laptop

palusot.title: Pula Lang ang Nakita Ko
palusot.what: he pastes the error to AI without reading it
palusot.hook_seed: Claude, ayusin mo na lang. Basta gumana.
palusot.plain_fix: read the error first; it usually says what is wrong

palusot.title: Kaya 'Yan Bukas
palusot.what: he says yes to a deadline before he knows what it is
palusot.hook_seed: Opo, Ma'am! Kaya po 'yan bukas!
palusot.tanong_seed: Alam mo na ba kung ano 'yan, boss?
palusot.plain_fix: ask what it is before you say yes

palusot.title: Nasa Laptop Lahat
palusot.what: everything is on one laptop and nowhere else
palusot.hook_seed: Safe 'yan. Nasa laptop ko lahat.
palusot.plain_fix: keep a second copy somewhere else
palusot.frame_note: the laptop in a place it could be lost: a boat, a jeep, rain

palusot.title: Kasama ang Susi
palusot.what: he posts his code with the secret key inside
palusot.hook_seed: Pinost ko na sa group ang code ko! Open source na!
palusot.plain_fix: keep keys out of the code
palusot.watch: show no real key format or real service name on screen

palusot.title: AI Expert Na Ako
palusot.what: a title earned in one webinar
palusot.hook_seed: AI expert na ako. Naka-attend na ako ng webinar.
palusot.plain_fix: make something before you claim it

palusot.title: Noted Po
palusot.what: he says 'noted' to something he did not understand
palusot.hook_seed: Noted po, Sir! Malinaw na malinaw po.
palusot.plain_fix: ask when you do not understand

palusot.title: Naka-Seen
palusot.what: he leaves a client on seen and pretends he never got it
palusot.hook_seed: Hindi ko pa nababasa, promise.
palusot.plain_fix: answer, even when the answer is no

palusot.title: Startup Ko 'To
palusot.what: a tutorial project renamed a startup
palusot.hook_seed: Startup ko 'to. Pang-unicorn 'to.
palusot.plain_fix: solve somebody's real problem

palusot.title: Resibo
palusot.what: subscriptions he pays for and does not use
palusot.hook_seed: Kailangan ko 'yan lahat. Para sa productivity.
palusot.tanong_seed: Alin dito ang ginamit mo ngayong linggo, boss?
palusot.plain_fix: add it up before you subscribe again
palusot.watch: every price on the receipt verified; none spoken

palusot.title: Exposure Na Lang
palusot.what: he takes exposure as payment
palusot.hook_seed: Okay lang po. Exposure na lang ang bayad.
palusot.plain_fix: put a price on your work before anyone else does
palusot.watch: close to libre-kasi-ai: here Buloy offers it himself; wait three episodes after it

palusot.title: Ako Na sa Research
palusot.what: in a group project he takes 'research', meaning he will ask AI the night before
palusot.hook_seed: Ako na sa research. Madali lang 'yan.
palusot.plain_fix: know what your part is before you take it

palusot.title: Mamaya Na
palusot.what: 'I'll fix it later', every day
palusot.hook_seed: Mamaya ko na 'yan aayusin.
palusot.plain_fix: fix it while it is small

palusot.title: Biyernes Naman
palusot.what: he ships on a Friday night
palusot.hook_seed: I-deploy na natin. Biyernes naman, chill lang.
palusot.tanong_seed: Sino'ng gising bukas kung masira, boss?
palusot.plain_fix: ship when someone is awake to fix it

palusot.title: Secure 'Yan
palusot.what: his 'secure' password is his dog's name
palusot.hook_seed: Secure 'yan. May password.
palusot.plain_fix: a password nobody can guess from your Facebook

palusot.title: Programmer Ka 'Di Ba
palusot.what: he says yes to fixing anything electronic because he 'works with computers'
palusot.hook_seed: Programmer ka 'di ba? Ayusin mo nga 'tong printer.
palusot.tanong_seed: Marunong ka bang mag-ayos ng printer, boss?
palusot.plain_fix: say plainly what your work is
palusot.watch: the hook is the guest's; Buloy's yes is the palusot, said in the next line

palusot.title: Juan Dela Cruz
palusot.what: the demo only works on made-up data
palusot.hook_seed: Gumagana po, Sir! Tingnan n'yo.
palusot.plain_fix: test with the data you will really get

palusot.title: Viral Na Ako
palusot.what: his 'viral' post was liked by family
palusot.hook_seed: Viral na ako! Ang daming likes!
palusot.plain_fix: know who is really watching

palusot.title: Na-Automate Ko Na
palusot.what: the automation took longer than doing it by hand
palusot.hook_seed: Na-automate ko na! Pipindot na lang.
palusot.plain_fix: check it is worth automating first

palusot.title: Sigurado Raw
palusot.what: he trusts a confident AI answer without checking
palusot.hook_seed: Sabi ng AI, tama 'to. Sigurado raw.
palusot.plain_fix: check it; Claude says himself he can be sure and wrong
palusot.frame_note: Claude's honesty is the escalation: 'Ako 'yon, boss. Minsan, sigurado ako at mali.'

palusot.title: Legit Ba Ako
palusot.what: he doubts he is a real developer because he still searches the basics
palusot.hook_seed: Claude, legit developer ba ako?
palusot.plain_fix: ship something people use; nobody remembers everything, not even Claude

palusot.title: Atin-atin Lang
palusot.what: he would rather keep his workflow secret than share it, and Claude offers to help him do exactly that
palusot.hook_seed: Claude, bakit ang dami kong DMs?
palusot.amin_seed: "Anong app gamit mo sa mga videos mo, boss?"
palusot.plain_fix: share the workflow, step by step, for free; one page answers every DM
